faq.question: How long does a typical screen or battery repair take?
faq.answer: Most phone screen and battery replacements take between 30 to 45 minutes. Laptops and complex logic board servicing generally take 1 to 2 hours.

faq.question: Do you provide a warranty on repairs?
faq.answer: Yes! Every hardware repair comes with our comprehensive 90-day parts and labor warranty.

faq.question: Will my personal data remain safe during servicing?
faq.answer: Absolutely. We adhere to strict customer data privacy protocols and do not require your device passcode unless diagnostics specifically demand testing.

faq.question: Can I get a quote before committing to the repair?
faq.answer: Yes. Our initial diagnostic quote is completely transparent and free. We only proceed once you approve the estimate.
